map.本地检测密码强度，估算暴力破解时间，所有计算在浏览器完成，密码不上传。: Check password strength and estimate brute-force time locally — everything runs in the browser and your password is never uploaded.
map.评估口令的强度与抗破解能力。: Assess how strong a password is and how well it resists cracking.
map.：长度、字符种类（大小写、数字、符号）、是否为常见口令或字典词、是否含个人信息。: : length, character classes (upper- and lowercase, digits, symbols), whether it is a common password or dictionary word, and whether it contains personal information.
map.：熵 ≈ 长度 × log₂(字符池大小)，位数越高暴力破解成本越大。: : entropy ≈ length × log₂(pool size); the more bits, the more expensive brute force becomes.
map.：优先保证长度（≥12 位）与唯一性，复杂度要求次之；应检查是否出现在已泄露口令: : prioritize length (≥12 characters) and uniqueness over complexity requirements, and check whether the password appears in a breach corpus.
map.：使用弱口令、个人信息、跨站重复使用的口令。: : weak passwords, personal information, and passwords reused across sites.
map.评估口令熵与常见弱点。: Assess a password's entropy and common weaknesses.
map.自查口令风险：启用新口令前先测一遍，看是否属于常见组合或已泄露的口令，而不是只看: Audit your own password risk: test a new password before you start using it to see whether it is a common pattern or an already-breached one, instead of only looking at length.
map.`password123` → 弱（常见词+顺序数字，熵低）；`Tq7!mK9@: `password123` → weak (a common word plus sequential digits, low entropy); `Tq7!mK9@pL2#` → strong.
map.长度与字符集共同决定熵，词典词会大幅削弱。: Length and character set together determine entropy, and dictionary words weaken it substantially.
map.提示「很强」就一定安全吗？: Does "very strong" mean it is definitely safe?
map.不一定。强度评估基于熵与常见模式，无法覆盖所有风险：这个口令是否已在别处泄露过、: Not necessarily. The strength estimate is based on entropy and common patterns and cannot cover every risk: whether this password has already leaked elsewhere, is reused with another account, or has been phished is something the tool has no way of knowing. So beyond the score, what matters more is one password per account, storing them in a password manager, and turning on two-factor authentication for important accounts.
map.大小写字母 + 数字 + 符号组合: A mix of upper- and lowercase letters, digits and symbols
map.字典词、个人信息、连续/重复序列: Dictionary words, personal information, and sequential or repeated runs
map.越高越难暴力破解，随机性是关键: The higher the better against brute force; randomness is what counts
map.参考 OWASP / NIST 指南：优先使用长口令短语，而非强制频繁更换短密码: Per the OWASP and NIST guidance, prefer long passphrases over forcing frequent changes of short passwords.
